source_provenance.verification: 94 observable row-to-row balance deltas across two read-only originals

source_direction_contract: Physical DR decreases balance and maps to canonical debit; physical CR increases balance and maps to canonical credit.
sanitisation_method: A non-reversible fictional balance path preserves the observed Axis CSV header grammar, physical DR/CR occupancy classes, source ordering, exact two-decimal INR scale and both UPI and non-UPI row families. No original identifier, reference, narration, date or financial value is retained.
source_truth_boundary: This derivative establishes NRE layout and conventional DR/CR semantics only. Full private originals remain local read-only evidence and are verified separately outside the test bundle.
